title: Pasta e Fagioli
ingredients: 2 carrots, peeled and very finely chopped
400g can borlotti beans, drained and rinsed
400g can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
125g small dried pasta shapes or macaroni
steps: Fry onion, celery and carrots in cooking spray for about 10 minutes until softened.
Stir in garlic, rosemary and oregano; stir-fry 30 seconds.
Pour in passata and stock; bring to a rapid simmer. Add both cans of beans; simmer 10 minutes.
Remove one-third of the soup and blend; return to pan.
Tip in pasta; season; simmer 20 minutes until pasta is cooked.
Stir through spinach and lemon juice; check seasoning. Serve scattered with parsley.
notes: Also use butter beans or kidney beans; replace spinach with kale. Freshly grated Parmesan is delicious on top.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
